examples.translation: The evil demon of the Christian belief, the devil of the middle ages, was according to the Christian mythology a fallen angel himself and of godlike nature.
examples.english: The evil demon of the Christian belief, the devil of the middle ages, was according to the Christian mythology a fallen angel himself and of godlike nature.

examples.text: „Er kam ihm ganz und gar nicht wie ein brillantes gottgleiches Wesen vor.“
„Von der Polizei gesucht und gefürchtet, ist ihm etwas Übermenschliches, Gottgleiches gelungen: Er ist gestorben und wiederauferstanden.“

glosses: Having the characteristics of a god.

examples.text: Man himself had been his greatest blunder; he had created a rival to himself; science makes men godlike — it is all up with priests and gods when man becomes scientific!
When a normal ensign looked at his commander, he ought to see a godlike being, not a, a... future subordinate.
Godlike aliens! Man, do I hate godlike aliens! I'll trade a critter for a godlike alien, any day!
And each imagin'd pinnacle and steep / Of godlike hardship tells me I must die / Like a sick Eagle looking at the sky.
Beneficence is godlike, and he who does most good to his fellow-man is the Master of Masters, and has learned the Art of Arts.
It took the combined skills of three great civilizations far apart in time to frame that godlike concept in which the tangible universe itself was only a single factor.
Der böse Dämon des christlichen Glaubens, der Teufel des Mittelalters, war nach der christlichen Mythologie selbst ein gefallener Engel und gottgleicher Natur.
examples.translation: 基督教信仰中的恶魔，即中世纪的魔鬼，根据基督教神话，他本人是一位堕落的天使，具有神性的本质。
